passage:
A large tree stood in the middle of the school yard. Students sat under it, took pictures near it, and used it as a meeting place.
One day, the school announced that the tree was sick. Some branches were dangerous, and experts said it had to be cut down.
Many students were sad. The school decided to save part of the tree trunk and turn it into a long bench. Students also planted three young trees nearby.
Months later, the old tree was gone, but the bench was always full of students. The young trees were small, but they grew new leaves.
The school learned that saying goodbye does not always mean forgetting. Sometimes it means changing the way something stays with us.
